# Alison

> > Alison is a free online learning platform offering certificates, diplomas, and professional development courses across 15+ subject areas to 15 million graduates worldwide.

Alison provides accessible online education through free courses and recognized certifications in IT, health, business, languages, and personal development. The platform supports multiple languages including Spanish and English, with CPD accreditation for professional learners seeking career advancement and skill development.

## Course Categories

- [Free Online IT and Computing Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/it): Free IT and computing courses covering programming, cybersecurity, web dev
- [Free Online Business Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/business): Free business courses: finance, management, leadership, entrepreneurship
- [Free Online Management Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/management): Free management courses for leadership skills and career advancement
- [Free Online Health and Medicine Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/health): Free health and medicine courses: caregiving, nutrition, fitness, wellness
- [Free Online Language Courses | Learn a Language | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/language): Free language courses: French, German, Spanish, Italian, English learning
- [Free Online Sales & Marketing Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/marketing): Free sales and marketing courses for effective techniques and upskilling
- [Free Online Personal Development Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/personal-development): Free personal development courses: time management, motivation, self-improvement
- [Free Online Engineering & Construction Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/engineering): Free engineering and construction courses: design, problem-solving, innovation
- [Free Online Teaching & Academics Courses | Alison](https://alison.com/courses/education): Free teaching and education courses: curriculum, teaching techniques, training

- [Business Management & Administration careers | Alison](https://alison.com/careers/management): Business management career guide: planning, people management, HR, leadership
